integrity: The proof derives an exact scale-by-scale denominator profile from a complete support-functional reduction of Birkhoff orthogonality, then performs an analytic one-variable optimization. The bundled checker reconstructs the polygonal norm and tests the support cases and formula on deterministic grids; finite tests are supplementary and not used as a proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes the exponent-generalized rectangular constant only for the Euclidean regular octagonal norm. It does not classify arbitrary regular polygons or affine octagonal deformations, and it leaves the equality exponent between the two explicit branches in implicit form.
title: Exact \(\mu_p\) profile of the regular octagonal Banach plane
